## Plugin reference

- Description: Umbrella for music building blocks shared across apps, knowing pitch classes, strings and sound only: the chord box (a chord's degree colour, numeral and tile) and the ambient engine (generative WebAudio music and sound effects).
- Sub-plugins:
  - **`ambient`** — Generative ambient music in WebAudio, no samples: createAmbient(ctx, { mood }) plays a mood (lofi — a swung 72 bpm Rhodes loop with drums and vinyl crackle; ambient — slow pads, bells, surf and…
  - **`chord-box`** — The chord box: <ChordBox> (a frame painted in the colour of its numeral's number — filled tile, given or empty — holding its numeral and name, with a full-bleed hit button behind the content and now…
